svg.title: Packing list validation
svg.desc: Four validation stages after parser selection and extraction. Remove empty lines, check every remaining product line including conditional NIRMS, country and ineligible-goods rules, assess the whole list, then report pass or fail and clear invalid numbers. All applicable failures are collected; a failure does not stop later checks.
svg.text: Packing list validation
After parser selection and extraction | Collect every applicable failure; do not stop at the first error
Parsed packing list and extracted product lines
STAGE 1: Remove empty product lines
Remove lines with only null or undefined data fields
Ignore row location. A line containing an empty string is retained.
If no lines remain, skip Stage 2 and record this in Stage 3.
Remaining lines
No lines remain
STAGE 2: Validate each remaining product line
Check all core product fields
Identifier: commodity code OR both nature and treatment
Supplied commodity code: digits only after removing whitespace
Product description: not empty
Packages and net weight: not empty, numeric and non-negative
Unit: contains kg, kgs, kilo, kilos, kilogram or kilograms
Unit matching ignores case and accepts a match within a longer value.
Country-of-origin
validation enabled?
No
Yes
Validate NIRMS designation and country
Require a recognised NIRMS or non-NIRMS designation.
For NIRMS lines: require country of origin and valid ISO codes.
Split multiple country codes on commas or ampersands.
Every part must be valid; record missing or invalid values.
Designation and country matching ignore case and surrounding spaces.
NIRMS line with
present, valid country
and a commodity code?
No: skip goods assessment
Yes
Assess ineligible goods across all listed countries
Match country rules and commodity-code prefixes.
No matching rules: no ineligible finding.
Any ! exceptions: allow only if treatment matches any exception.
Otherwise: prohibit if any rule has no treatment, the line has
no treatment, or treatments match. Record prohibited items.
Trim line treatment; compare ignoring case. Exceptions take precedence.
Keep all line failures and repeat Stage 2 for every line
A failed check never prevents the other applicable checks.
STAGE 3: Validate the packing list as a whole
Combine line failures with list-wide checks
Registration approval number must be present.
Parser must not report a missing registration number.
At least one product line must remain after empty-line removal.
No more than one establishment number may be listed.
All applicable
checks pass?
Yes
No
STAGE 4: Report results and clean invalid numbers
PASS
Mark as having all required fields
FAIL
Mark as missing required fields
Attach failure reasons where checks failed
Retain semicolon-separated messages on each product line.
Include row, sheet and row, or page and row locations.
Show the first three locations per failure, then a count of the remainder.
Replace invalid package counts and net weights with null
Keep their product lines and previously recorded failures.
Return validation result
Header weight units and blanket NIRMS statements may change messages, but do not excuse missing line values.
